s: Seder seuddat shacharit shel shabbat ubo g' seipim: beshabbat shacharit beboo mibbet hakkeneset — tzarik sheyyihyeh shulchano aruk umappa perusa al happat, mittaam shennitbaer besimman ra"a, umitta sheokel aleha mutztzaat yapeh kemo bisuddat hallayla, lepi shekkebod yom qodem likbod layla:

Vetiqqenu chakamim leqaddesh al hayyayin qodem seuddat shacharit kemo qodem seuddat hallayla, lepi shekkebod yom qodem likbod layla, veim lo yeqaddesh bayyom al hayyayin yehe kebod layla odep al kebod yom. Mikkol maqom, lo tiqqenu lebarek birkat haqqiddush shebberak ballayla, ella day bebirkat "bore peri haggapen" sheyyebarek al hayyayin, kede sheyyehe hekker bazeh sheqqiddush zeh eno ella middibre soperim. Umikkol maqom, gam zeh haqqiddush tzarik sheyyihyeh bimqom seudda, veshello yitom kelum qodem lo kemo beqiddush hallayla. Ak muttar lishtot mayim qodem tepillat hashshachar, mippene sheadayin lo chal alayv chobat qiddush. Veyesh omerim shemmuttar litom qodem qiddush shebbayyom, hoil veiqqaro eno ella middibre soperim — lo hechemiru bo kol kak. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq, kegon sheen lo yayin velo shear mashqeh "chamar medina", apillu im gam pat en lo — yakol leekol shear maakalim qodem qiddush zeh. Ap im metzappeh sheyyabiu lo achar zeman al ma leqaddesh — en tzarik lehamtin. Veim yesh lo pat — tzarik lebarek al happat techilla qodem sheyyokal shear maakalim, shehare yesh omerim sheap lekattechilla yakol leqaddesh al happat, dehaynu lebarek "hammotzi" aleha, kemo shennitbaer besimman ar"b. Veim yesh lo "chamar medina" ap sheen lo yayin — lo yitom kelum, apillu pat, qodem sheyyebarek al hakkos, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Abal ballayla im en lo lo yayin velo "chamar medina" velo pat leqaddesh alehem, umetzappeh sheyyabiu lo echad mehem tok hallayla — lo yitom kelum mishshear maakalim ad sheyyabiu lo al mah leqaddesh, veyesh lo lehamtin al kol panim ad chatzot layla. Abal im eno metzappeh sheyyabiu lo ballayla — muttar lo leekol shear hammaakalim belo qiddush, veeno mechuyyab lalun betaanit beshabbat bishbil qiddush al hayyayin o al happat, hoil ukebar yatza yede chobat iqqar qiddush shel tora bemah shehizkir shel shabbat bitpillat arbit:
